summary.text: Cody Wylie is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 39, serving since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Cody Wylie was born in Rock Springs, Wyoming, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming in 2011.
Wylie's career experience includes working as a construction manager, and as of 2022 he served on the Rock Springs planning and zoning board.
Wylie assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 2, 2023, succeeding Marshall Burt.
For 2025-2026, Wylie serves on the House Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee.
